jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single inventory item icon for Wasteland Chronicles, an understated late-1990s isometric wasteland RPG with a Survivor PDA interface.
Style: original hand-painted realistic game item illustration with restrained coarse texture, clear bold silhouette, lightly worn surfaces; not a photograph, not vector clipart, not cute, not glossy 3D mobile-game art.
View and lighting: three-quarter object view, consistent soft light from upper left, distinct light edge against dark charcoal UI, muted olive/steel/dirty ivory/rust palette.
Composition: one centered item or the specified small grouped item, fills about 80% of a square 1024x1024 canvas, entire object visible with generous transparent margins. The silhouette must remain readable at 32 to 48 pixels.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object, no vignette, no card border, no UI.
No words, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermark or extra props.
Subject: One sturdy flattened oval metal drinking-water canteen with faded blue enamel, a simple screw cap and a small canvas strap. Distinctive blue-grey bottle silhouette; clearly a water canteen, not a fuel container.
